Marketing Coordinator

Harpeth Outdoor Co. · Franklin, TN · Hybrid (2 days in office)

Harpeth Outdoor Co. makes canoes, paddles and camp gear in Middle Tennessee. We're a 40-person company that grew out of a weekend rental shack on the Harpeth River, and we still close early on the first warm Friday of spring.

The role

You'll run our email newsletter, coordinate our spring and fall paddle festivals, and help our small team keep social media consistent. You'll report to our Head of Marketing, Priya Raman.

You have

  • 2+ years in a marketing coordinator or similar role
  • Experience writing and sending email newsletters to a list of a few thousand people or more
  • Experience organizing events with volunteers
  • Clear, friendly writing

Bonus points

  • Experience with Canva
  • You've spent time on a river

Pay: $48,000–$56,000 plus a gear allowance. To apply, send your resume and a cover letter.
